items.title: Henry takes six as New Zealand thrash India by 244 runs
items.summary: Matt Henry took six wickets and Will Young struck a century as New Zealand thrashed a ragged India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui on Friday. Henry removed Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer all without scoring in the first over of India’s chase to tear the top order apart with the visitors needing a massive 334 for victory.
